svg.text: 34 automatic SMT parts on F.Cu. U10 sockets on B.Cu and J30 are hand-fitted.
PCB-editor top view. Red IC pads mark pad 1.
SMT assembly key — 20 capacitors, 11 resistors, 3 ICs
Seven red-ring vias specify epoxy fill, planarization, and copper capping. See U1-VIA-TREATMENT.svg.
Manual sockets/Pico, J30, and the front logo are excluded from automatic SMT assembly.
